messages:
claire: Quick pass on the "lunar" dark theme mock — overall nice, a few accessibility and copy nits. Charts feel washed at thumbnail sizes, and inline snippets disappear against the panel. Screenshot: https://mock.img/snap.png :mag:
noah: I see that. Sparkline color is too low-contrast at 10px. Suggest boosting luminance for primary series and adding a 1px stroke for tiny lines.
ria: Code blocks: current bg is close to panel color, making `POST /v1/generate` hard to read. Propose code-bg #0f1b2a and code-text #eaf4ff. Also increase padding to 12px.
claire: Copy tweak: replace "Token usage by route" -> "Token usage — by route" (em dash for clarity). Also tooltip for theme toggle is misleading; change to "Toggle between light and dark themes".
design-bot: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/452 with color var updates and code padding. CI: visual diff flagged for chart snapshots.
noah: For charts try shifting gradient midpoint from 50% to 30% and desaturate fills. That keeps peaks vivid but brightens midtones.
ria: Accessibility request: add a "High contrast charts" option under Settings -> Accessibility (off by default). Useful for demos and folks who need clearer lines.
claire: Action items: noah adjust gradients; ria update code styles & copy; claire will run contrast audit after PR lands. Aim for staging deploy tomorrow.
noah: OK will push change today. :thumbsup:
